submission.implementation_notes: Iterative Fibonacci compiled with Plinth 1.61.0.0 (plutus-core 1.61.0.0). Demonstrates the impact of a newer compiler version on UPLC code generation. Requires plutus-core >= 1.61.0.0, which mainnet has run since the van Rossem hard fork (protocol version 11, 2026-07-18).
